notes: The speed is in the song’s own settings now, where the rest of that song’s options are - a slider from 0.5x to 2x with a Reset beside it, and it says so: this song only.
It never was the whole player’s. That slider used to move every song at once; it now writes the rate to the song you opened and to nothing else, and the speed chip that sat on the now bar is gone.
Download crossfaded mix keeps it: each song is stretched by its own rate before the blend, so a mix of songs you sped up sounds the way they sound in the app, with the pitch left alone.
A song left at 1x makes exactly the mix it made before, and the Studio rate still stacks on top.
